<thought>To locate a template for the Friedel‑Crafts acylation we should search for templates that break an “acyl chloride” group (the C–Cl bond of the acyl chloride reagent) and form a “ketone” group on the aromatic ring. This matches the forward reaction description and should retrieve the appropriate retrosynthetic template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccc(CNc2c(C(=O)Nc3cccc(OC)c3)nnn2Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["acyl chloride"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
